hp.en: Harry was reluctant to tell Ron about his strange dream.
hp.zh: 哈利不情願告訴榮恩他那個奇怪的夢。

hp.en: Neville looked reluctant to open the door of the dark classroom.
hp.zh: 奈威看起來不情願打開那間陰暗教室的門。

extra.en: Mia was reluctant to speak in front of the whole class.
extra.zh: 米亞不情願在全班面前發言。

extra.en: He gave a reluctant smile when his mom asked him to clean his room.
extra.zh: 媽媽叫他整理房間時，他勉強地笑了一下。

hp.en: Hermione is ambitious and wants the highest grade in every class.
hp.zh: 妙麗很有野心，想在每一堂課都拿最高分。

hp.en: Draco is ambitious, but he often depends on his father.
hp.zh: 跩哥很有野心，但他常常依賴父親。

extra.en: The ambitious young chef dreams of opening his own restaurant.
extra.zh: 這位有野心的年輕廚師夢想開一間自己的餐廳。

extra.en: Our team set an ambitious goal of collecting one thousand books.
extra.zh: 我們的團隊訂下收集一千本書的遠大目標。

hp.en: Professor Flitwick warned that the crystal ball was very fragile.
hp.zh: 孚立維教授警告說那顆水晶球非常易碎。

hp.en: After the long battle, Harry felt fragile and tired.
hp.zh: 漫長的戰鬥後，哈利覺得自己脆弱又疲憊。

extra.en: Please be careful with this box; the glasses inside are fragile.
extra.zh: 請小心這個箱子，裡面的玻璃杯很易碎。

extra.en: Trust is fragile, and it takes time to rebuild.
extra.zh: 信任很脆弱，重建需要時間。

hp.en: Hagrid is loyal to Dumbledore, and he never doubts him.
hp.zh: 海格對鄧不利多忠心耿耿，從不懷疑他。

hp.en: Ron proved to be a loyal friend in the hardest moments.
hp.zh: 榮恩在最艱難的時刻證明了自己是忠實的朋友。

extra.en: Dogs are known to be loyal to their owners.
extra.zh: 狗以對主人忠誠聞名。

extra.en: She is a loyal customer who visits the shop every week.
extra.zh: 她是忠實的顧客，每週都來這家店。

hp.en: The Slytherin students were known to be clever and cunning.
hp.zh: 史萊哲林的學生以聰明又狡猾聞名。

hp.en: Fred and George made a cunning plan to leave the school.
hp.zh: 弗雷和喬治想出一個機靈的計畫來離開學校。

extra.en: The cunning fox tricked the crow into dropping its food.
extra.zh: 狡猾的狐狸騙烏鴉掉下牠的食物。

extra.en: He made a cunning plan to win the board game.
extra.zh: 他想出一個機靈的計畫來贏得這場桌遊。

hp.en: A mysterious voice whispered to Harry from inside the walls.
hp.zh: 一個神祕的聲音從牆裡對哈利低語。

hp.en: Hermione wanted to know who sent Harry the mysterious broom.
hp.zh: 妙麗想知道是誰寄給哈利那支神祕的掃帚。

extra.en: We found a mysterious letter with no name under our door.
extra.zh: 我們在門下發現一封沒有署名的神祕信件。

extra.en: The old house at the end of the street looks dark and mysterious.
extra.zh: 街尾那棟老房子看起來陰暗又神祕。

hp.en: Ron was desperate to finish his essay before Snape's class.
hp.zh: 榮恩拚命想在石內卜的課之前寫完報告。

hp.en: Harry made a desperate attempt to save Sirius from the Dementors.
hp.zh: 哈利不顧一切地想從催狂魔手中救出天狼星。

extra.en: After walking for hours, the hikers were desperate for water.
extra.zh: 走了好幾個小時後，登山客極度渴望喝水。

extra.en: Losing by twenty points, the team was in a desperate situation.
extra.zh: 落後二十分，這支隊伍陷入絕望的處境。

hp.en: Neville was so clumsy that he dropped his wand twice in one lesson.
hp.zh: 奈威笨手笨腳的，一堂課就把魔杖掉了兩次。

hp.en: Tonks felt clumsy after she knocked over the umbrella stand again.
hp.zh: 東施又撞倒傘架之後，覺得自己真是笨手笨腳。

extra.en: I was clumsy this morning and spilled milk all over the table.
extra.zh: 我今天早上笨手笨腳的，把牛奶灑得整桌都是。

extra.en: The puppy is still clumsy and often trips over its own feet.
extra.zh: 小狗還很笨拙，常常被自己的腳絆倒。

hp.en: Uncle Vernon was furious when the letters kept flying into the house.
hp.zh: 信件不斷飛進屋裡，威農姨丈氣炸了。

hp.en: Mrs. Weasley was furious when Fred and George set off fireworks in the kitchen.
hp.zh: 弗雷和喬治在廚房放煙火，衛斯理太太氣得火冒三丈。

extra.en: My sister was furious when someone ate her birthday cake.
extra.zh: 有人吃了我姊姊的生日蛋糕，她氣壞了。

extra.en: The driver was furious about the long traffic jam.
extra.zh: 司機對漫長的塞車感到非常憤怒。

hp.en: Harry was grateful that Dobby warned him about the danger.
hp.zh: 哈利很感激多比警告他有危險。

hp.en: Hagrid felt grateful when Dumbledore let him stay at Hogwarts.
hp.zh: 鄧不利多讓海格留在霍格華茲，海格心懷感激。

extra.en: I am grateful to my teacher for her patience.
extra.zh: 我很感激老師的耐心。

extra.en: The family was grateful for the neighbors' help after the storm.
extra.zh: 暴風雨過後，這家人很感謝鄰居的幫忙。

hp.en: Hermione tried to convince Ron to start studying earlier.
hp.zh: 妙麗試著說服榮恩早點開始讀書。

hp.en: It was hard to convince Professor McGonagall that the story was true.
hp.zh: 要讓麥教授相信這個故事是真的很困難。

extra.en: I could not convince my brother to share his snacks.
extra.zh: 我沒辦法說服弟弟分享他的零食。

extra.en: The doctor tried to convince him to sleep earlier.
extra.zh: 醫生試著說服他早點睡。

hp.en: Harry would never abandon his friends, even in great danger.
hp.zh: 即使身陷險境，哈利也絕不會拋下朋友。

hp.en: Ron refused to abandon Scabbers, even though the rat was old and sick.
hp.zh: 榮恩不肯拋棄斑斑，即使那隻老鼠又老又病。

extra.en: Never abandon a pet just because it is getting old.
extra.zh: 千萬不要因為寵物變老就拋棄牠。

extra.en: Heavy rain forced us to abandon our plan for a picnic.
extra.zh: 大雨迫使我們放棄野餐的計畫。

hp.en: Snape liked to accuse Harry of breaking school rules.
hp.zh: 石內卜喜歡指責哈利違反校規。

hp.en: It is not fair to accuse Hagrid without any proof.
hp.zh: 沒有任何證據就指控海格並不公平。

extra.en: Please don't accuse me of lying; I'm telling the truth.
extra.zh: 請不要指責我說謊，我說的是實話。

extra.en: The store owner tried to accuse the boy of stealing candy.
extra.zh: 店老闆試圖指控那個男孩偷糖果。

hp.en: Voldemort wanted to conquer the whole wizarding world.
hp.zh: 佛地魔想要征服整個魔法世界。

hp.en: Neville worked hard to conquer his fear of Snape.
hp.zh: 奈威努力克服對石內卜的恐懼。

extra.en: She finally learned to conquer her fear of deep water.
extra.zh: 她終於學會克服對深水的恐懼。

extra.en: The army tried to conquer the small island.
extra.zh: 軍隊試圖征服那座小島。

hp.en: Harry and Ron drank a potion to disguise themselves as Crabbe and Goyle.
hp.zh: 哈利和榮恩喝下魔藥，把自己偽裝成克拉和高爾。

hp.en: Sirius could disguise himself as a big black dog.
hp.zh: 天狼星能把自己偽裝成一隻大黑狗。

extra.en: He wore glasses and a hat to disguise himself at the party.
extra.zh: 他在派對上戴眼鏡和帽子來偽裝自己。

extra.en: She tried to disguise her voice on the phone.
extra.zh: 她講電話時試著偽裝自己的聲音。

hp.en: Harry had to endure another long summer with the Dursleys.
hp.zh: 哈利得再忍受和德思禮一家度過一個漫長的暑假。

hp.en: The students could hardly endure the cold in the dungeon classroom.
hp.zh: 學生們幾乎無法忍受地窖教室裡的寒冷。

extra.en: We had to endure three hours of waiting at the airport.
extra.zh: 我們在機場忍受了三個小時的等待。

extra.en: Some desert animals can endure very high temperatures.
extra.zh: 有些沙漠動物能忍受極高的溫度。

hp.en: Hogwarts rules forbid first-years to bring their own brooms.
hp.zh: 霍格華茲的校規禁止一年級新生帶自己的掃帚。

hp.en: Mrs. Weasley wanted to forbid the twins from selling joke products at home.
hp.zh: 衛斯理太太想禁止雙胞胎在家裡賣惡作劇商品。

extra.en: Many parks forbid people to feed the birds.
extra.zh: 許多公園禁止民眾餵鳥。

extra.en: My parents forbid me to use my phone at the dinner table.
extra.zh: 爸媽禁止我在餐桌上用手機。

hp.en: Fred and George loved to imitate Percy's serious voice.
hp.zh: 弗雷和喬治很愛模仿派西嚴肅的聲音。

hp.en: A boggart can imitate the thing you fear the most.
hp.zh: 幻形怪能模仿你最害怕的東西。

extra.en: Young children often imitate their parents.
extra.zh: 小孩子常常模仿父母。

extra.en: This bird can imitate the sound of a ringing phone.
extra.zh: 這種鳥能模仿電話鈴聲。

hp.en: Harry dived into the lake to rescue Ron during the second task.
hp.zh: 在第二項任務中，哈利潛入湖裡去救榮恩。

hp.en: Harry and Hermione went back in time to rescue Buckbeak.
hp.zh: 哈利和妙麗回到過去去救巴嘴。

extra.en: Firefighters arrived quickly to rescue the family.
extra.zh: 消防員迅速趕到，救出那一家人。

extra.en: The volunteers work hard to rescue stray cats.
extra.zh: 志工們努力救援流浪貓。

hp.en: Neville's hands began to tremble when Snape looked at him.
hp.zh: 石內卜一看著奈威，他的手就開始發抖。

hp.en: The whole castle seemed to tremble during the battle.
hp.zh: 戰鬥期間，整座城堡似乎都在震動。

extra.en: My legs started to tremble before I went on stage.
extra.zh: 上台前我的腿開始發抖。

extra.en: The windows began to tremble as the big truck passed by.
extra.zh: 大卡車經過時，窗戶開始震動。

hp.en: Each trial was an obstacle on the way to the Philosopher's Stone.
hp.zh: 每一道關卡都是通往魔法石路上的障礙。

hp.en: Fear was the biggest obstacle for Neville, not his skill.
hp.zh: 對奈威來說，最大的障礙是恐懼，而不是能力。

extra.en: A fallen tree was an obstacle on the mountain path.
extra.zh: 一棵倒下的樹成了山徑上的障礙。

extra.en: Lack of sleep can be an obstacle to learning.
extra.zh: 睡眠不足可能成為學習的障礙。

hp.en: Harry learned that his ancestor was one of the three Peverell brothers.
hp.zh: 哈利得知他的祖先是皮福雷三兄弟之一。

hp.en: The tapestry in Sirius's house showed every ancestor of the Black family.
hp.zh: 天狼星家的掛毯上畫著布萊克家族的每一位祖先。

extra.en: My ancestor came to Taiwan from Fujian about two hundred years ago.
extra.zh: 我的祖先大約兩百年前從福建來到台灣。

extra.en: During Tomb Sweeping Day, we honor every ancestor of our family.
extra.zh: 清明節時，我們祭拜家族的每一位祖先。

hp.en: Harry's curiosity led him to explore the castle at night.
hp.zh: 好奇心驅使哈利在夜裡探索城堡。

hp.en: Luna looked at the strange creature with great curiosity.
hp.zh: 露娜充滿好奇地看著那隻奇怪的生物。

extra.en: The boy's curiosity about space made him read many books.
extra.zh: 那男孩對太空的好奇心讓他讀了很多書。

extra.en: Out of curiosity, I opened the old box in the attic.
extra.zh: 出於好奇，我打開了閣樓裡的舊箱子。

hp.en: Harry woke up from a nightmare about a flash of green light.
hp.zh: 哈利從一場關於綠光閃現的惡夢中驚醒。

hp.en: Ron had a nightmare about giant spiders after visiting the forest.
hp.zh: 去過森林之後，榮恩做了一場關於巨大蜘蛛的惡夢。

extra.en: I had a nightmare that I was late for my final exam.
extra.zh: 我做了一場期末考遲到的惡夢。

extra.en: Being stuck in traffic for five hours was a total nightmare.
extra.zh: 塞車塞了五小時，簡直是一場惡夢。

hp.en: Hermione read the legend of the Chamber of Secrets in a history book.
hp.zh: 妙麗在一本歷史書中讀到了密室的傳說。

hp.en: According to an old legend, the Elder Wand cannot be defeated.
hp.zh: 根據古老的傳說，接骨木魔杖是無法被打敗的。

extra.en: There is a legend about a white snake living in the lake.
extra.zh: 有個傳說提到湖裡住著一條白蛇。

extra.en: The famous basketball player became a legend in his hometown.
extra.zh: 那位知名籃球員成了家鄉的傳奇人物。

hp.en: Fred and George were always looking for new mischief.
hp.zh: 弗雷和喬治總是在找新的惡作劇。

hp.en: Peeves caused mischief in the halls almost every day.
hp.zh: 皮皮鬼幾乎每天都在走廊上搗蛋。

extra.en: The kids got into mischief while their parents were busy cooking.
extra.zh: 父母忙著煮飯時，孩子們開始調皮搗蛋。

extra.en: My cat is full of mischief and knocks things off the table.
extra.zh: 我的貓很調皮，會把東西從桌上撥下去。

hp.en: Lily's sacrifice protected baby Harry from Voldemort.
hp.zh: 莉莉的犧牲保護了還是嬰兒的哈利不受佛地魔傷害。

hp.en: Dobby made a brave sacrifice to save his friends.
hp.zh: 多比為了救朋友，勇敢地犧牲了自己。

extra.en: Parents often make a sacrifice for their children's future.
extra.zh: 父母常常為了孩子的未來做出犧牲。

extra.en: Giving up video games before the exam was a small sacrifice.
extra.zh: 考試前放棄打電動是個小小的犧牲。

hp.en: Harry followed his instinct and turned left in the maze.
hp.zh: 哈利依照直覺在迷宮中左轉。

hp.en: A Seeker needs good instinct to catch the Golden Snitch.
hp.zh: 搜捕手需要好的直覺才能抓到金探子。

extra.en: Birds fly south in winter by instinct.
extra.zh: 鳥類憑本能在冬天往南飛。

extra.en: My first instinct was to run, but I stayed calm.
extra.zh: 我的第一個直覺是逃跑，但我保持了冷靜。

hp.en: Sirius wanted to be Harry's guardian and take him away from the Dursleys.
hp.zh: 天狼星想當哈利的監護人，把他從德思禮家帶走。

hp.en: Hagrid was like a guardian to Harry in his first days in the wizarding world.
hp.zh: 哈利剛進入魔法世界的那段日子，海格就像他的守護者。

extra.en: A parent or guardian must sign this form.
extra.zh: 這份表格必須由家長或監護人簽名。

extra.en: The old tree stands like a guardian at the village entrance.
extra.zh: 那棵老樹像守護者一樣矗立在村口。

hp.en: Sirius wanted revenge on the man who betrayed his best friend.
hp.zh: 天狼星想向背叛他摯友的人報仇。

hp.en: Draco planned his revenge after Hermione slapped him.
hp.zh: 妙麗打了跩哥一巴掌之後，他就計畫報復。

extra.en: Taking revenge will not make you feel better.
extra.zh: 報復並不會讓你感覺好過一點。

extra.en: The movie is about a man seeking revenge for his family.
extra.zh: 這部電影講的是一個男人為家人復仇的故事。
